observations: Photo 0 shows a large, vertically oriented engine block with a prominent cast aluminum cylinder head, characteristic of a V6 engine.
Photo 1 shows the same engine from a different angle, revealing a V6 configuration with multiple timing pulleys and a large air intake manifold.
The engine is surrounded by other mechanical components and hoses, suggesting it is part of a larger assembly.
The engine appears to be in a workshop or storage area with a dirty, wet floor.

claims.evidence: No Ford logo or F-150 badge is visible in the photos.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show a V6 configuration.
No model designation is visible on the engine block or in the photos.

risks.risk: The engine may not be compatible with the F-150 model or may have a different displacement.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
